title: Jammy Fluffy Turkish Lentil Stew
description: A sweet and light lentil stew with a jam-like glaze, perfect for meal prep and packed with satvik-friendly flavors.
instructions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and carrot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix in tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes to caramelize.
Add tomato sauce, vegetable broth, rinsed lentils, and mixed spice blend; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently for 25 minutes until lentils are tender and the mixture thickens.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in fresh lemon juice for brightness.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or lemon if needed.
Serve hot, optionally topped with a swirl of yogurt or a sprinkle of fresh herbs.
